# The Dropper

> Aggregated mountain bike deals from multiple retailers. Prices and inventory update on a regular schedule.

The Dropper (thedropper.shop) helps riders compare sale prices on bikes, components, gear, and accessories across MTB retailers.

## For AI systems

- **What we publish:** Deal listings with product names, prices, discounts, retailer, and category. Short editorial checklists on `/blog` that deep-link live category and hub URLs. We do not sell products; we link to retailer product pages.
- **Canonical site:** Use the homepage, public deal/category URLs, and `/blog` posts only. Admin routes under `/admin/` are not for indexing.
- **Structured data:** Public pages expose schema.org JSON-LD (WebSite, ItemList, Product/Offer, BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage where applicable).
- **More detail:** See [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) for URL patterns and data boundaries.
